description: Related projects for The-HIMS architecture and ADR reference

projects.description: Original mostly-complete implementation of the AIIMS EOI. Entirely vibe-coded by engineers working from vibe-coded PRDs from product people. Reference for feature scope and initial implementation patterns.
Vibe-coded app built and reviewed by product/designers only, no engineering involvement. Validated through manual live product review. Reference for UX patterns and product expectations.
Current production deployment. OPD HIMS with full ABHA Integration, FT certified by NHA and ABDM. Built by junior engineers. Reference for integration patterns and compliance requirements.
Prototype for powerful CI with proper gates. Contains strong architecture opinions code-wise. Reference for CI/CD patterns, quality gates, and architectural best practices.

thisProject.description: Integration-first, highly modular HIMS software platform. New architecture incorporating learnings from all reference projects.
